title: Vercel
visualIntent: A minimal developer-platform system with sharp typography, calm premium contrast, systematic sections, and strong product clarity.

compositionRecipes.label: Vercel default
compositionRecipes.whenToUse: Use this as the default build recipe whenever Vercel is the locked primary reference.
compositionRecipes.heroStructure: Build a technical product hero around one crisp product frame or UI surface, with severe hierarchy and no decorative lifestyle composition.
sectionOrder: Minimal technical hero with deploy or product framing.
Platform capability bands centered on product outcomes.
Sparse close with technical CTA and product confidence.
compositionRecipes.headlineImageRelationship: Keep the headline structurally tied to the product surface or code frame, but avoid loud overlap that would make the page feel editorial instead of technical.
layeringRules: Keep layering sparse and exact so the product remains dominant and the composition stays severe.
Use one dominant foreground relationship and one subordinate supporting layer; do not stack decorative layers without purpose.
Every overlap, crop, or z-index shift should strengthen the selected reference rather than adding generic drama.
compositionRecipes.typeScaleRelationship: Keep scale controlled and deliberate so one product frame or one precise headline leads the page.
compositionRecipes.paletteDistribution: Palette dominance should stay restrained, tonal, and disciplined, with accent color used sparingly.
compositionRecipes.imageFraming: Imagery should privilege product surfaces, code-adjacent UI, diagrams, or technical framing over lifestyle stock scenes.
compositionRecipes.asymmetry: Keep asymmetry restrained and category-correct rather than theatrical for its own sake.
compositionRecipes.ctaPosture: Keep CTAs sparse, exact, and product-native.
